summary.text: Peter Harckham is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 40 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Harckham has held the seat since 2019 and is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Peter Harckham has represented District 40 in the New York State Senate since 2019, succeeding Terrence Murphy (R).
Ballotpedia lists him as winning the general election for the seat in 2020 over Rob Astorino, and again in 2022 and 2024 over Gina Arena.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Environmental Conservation Committee and is also assigned to the Alcoholism and Substance Abuse, Rules, Transportation, Crime Victims, Crime and Correction, Insurance, and Veterans, Homeland Security and Military Affairs committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Harckham (D / Working Families Party) faces Sergio Esposito (R / Conservative Party).
